title: Old Austin prices: what changes value
author: codex-blog-rewrite
excerpt: Old Austin values depend mainly on model, structural condition, restoration quality, parts and the coherence of the file.
content:
Old Austin prices cannot be reduced to one single guide figure. The Austin name covers very different cars: pre-war Seven, family saloons, A40 Farina, Mini and Austin-Healey. Each has its own market, parts, public and weak points.

Figures change over time. The method of value is more stable: rarity, desirability, body condition, restoration quality, history and ability to drive without immediate work.

Value is a whole picture

The Austin page helps place each model in the marque. The Austin and Morris Mini page covers the best-known case for the wider public.
